page.title: Speak on Echo
page.intro: CamStack reads the notification text aloud on your Echo devices, through the Amazon accounts you already link under Integrations, Alexa. There is nothing to sign in to here. Add the targets from Notifications, Targets.

accounts.label: Amazon account
accounts.none: No Amazon account is linked yet. Link one under Integrations, Alexa, and its Echo devices show up here.

state.notSignedInHelp: This account has not signed in on its Integrations entry yet. Sign it in there, and speech starts a moment later without any step here.

notice.noBroker: Some Echo targets came from the old Speak on Echo sign-in, which no longer exists. Link your Amazon account under Integrations, Alexa, then open each target and pick the account.
notice.chooseBroker: Some Echo targets do not name an Amazon account yet, and several accounts are linked. Open each target and pick the account it speaks through.

devices.title: Echo devices
devices.help: Tick the devices or groups to try. A test uses the phrase below and does not change your rules.
devices.empty: No Echo devices yet. Once the account is signed in on its Integrations entry, they show up here.
